en.p: For the set $X=\{1,\,2,\,3,\,4\}$, a trial is performed in which one function is chosen at random from all functions $f:X\to X$. In this trial, given that the chosen function $f$ satisfies the following condition, what is the probability that $f(4)$ is even? [4 points]

box: For $a\in X$, $b\in X$: if $a$ is a divisor of $b$, then $f(a)$ is a divisor of $f(b)$.
